note: Root-level registry: one entry per module. Item-level work lives in docs/modules/<module>/feature_list.json. A module is 'done' only when every item in its module registry is 'done'.

features.name: Platform foundation
features.description: Repair the broken baseline left by the lending-app strip, swap the design system to the SafePermit palette/typography, build the app shell (dark sidebar + topbar, responsive drawer), wire i18n (en/th), contractor auth + route guard, the API client with backend error-code localization, and notification polling.

features.name: Permit core
features.description: Permit models/enums/safety-range constants, the permit provider, My Permits list, the 6-step New Permit wizard, Permit Detail (status banners, QR, audit timeline), the closure checklist modal with its blocked states, and the Fire Watch countdown.

features.name: History
features.description: Searchable, filterable, paginated permit history with CSV export and drill-in to permit detail. Reuses the permit provider from feat-002.

features.name: Certificates
features.description: Personnel certificate provider/models, certificate list with valid/expiring-soon/expired badges, add-certificate form, and the certificate gate that blocks permit submission for workers with a missing or expired cert.
